translation_versification_holds.reason: English and MT chapter numbering diverge across the mockery/work seam; numbering cannot decide the boundary.
The covenant transition crosses the English chapter seam while the MT places it at the opening of chapter 10.

chunks.literary_form: dated memoir report, lament, confession, and petition
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: dated memoir incipit; messenger report causes first-person mourning and a sustained direct-address prayer ending in the cupbearer notice
chunks.defensible_basis: The report is the narrated occasion for the prayer, and the closing office notice prepares the royal petition.

chunks.literary_form: royal petition and commission dialogue
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: new regnal date and court dialogue; requests culminate in royal letters and timber authorization
chunks.defensible_basis: Question, prayer, petition, counterquestion, and granted commission form one exchange.

chunks.literary_form: arrival, nocturnal survey, public appeal, and opposition response
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: arrival with letters shifts to nocturnal first-person inspection, then direct communal appeal and adversarial reply
chunks.defensible_basis: The inspection supplies the evidence for the appeal, whose acceptance and opposition complete the mission-opening scene.
chunks.low_hold: A qualified reviewer should test whether the arrival notice at 2:9-10 or survey at 2:11-16 is independently retrievable without losing the commission-to-building progression.

chunks.literary_form: gate-to-gate building register
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: repeated next-to-him repair syntax organizes a geographic circuit from the Sheep Gate back to its vicinity
chunks.defensible_basis: Names and local subsections serve one circuit-register function and should not be atomized.
chunks.low_hold: Gate, district, and repeated-builder syntax permits several defensible internal retrieval seams; retain the whole register while recording those exact alternatives.

chunks.literary_form: mockery, remembrance prayer, and resumed building
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: adversarial speech provokes first-person prayer; completion-to-half-height closes the taunt-prayer-work cycle
chunks.rejected_alternative: Neh.4.1-3 / Neh.4.4-6; MT Neh.3.33-38 as one unit
chunks.defensible_basis: The prayer and work response answer the taunt and belong together.
chunks.low_hold: WEB 4:1-6 is MT 3:33-38; versification and imprecatory wording require external translation review without selecting theology.

chunks.literary_form: conspiracy, prayer, defense, exhortation, and armed work
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: enemy coalition and plot initiate a watch/defense cycle; trumpet, guard, weapon, and labor instructions end in continuous vigilance
chunks.rejected_alternative: Neh.4.7-9 / Neh.4.10-14 / Neh.4.15-23; MT Neh.4.1-17 as one unit
chunks.defensible_basis: Threat, communal discouragement, exhortation, frustrated plot, and work-defense arrangement are mutually explanatory.
chunks.low_hold: WEB 4:7-23 is MT 4:1-17; work/watch/weapon syntax and changing speech scenes support internal seams but the larger response cycle is safer.

chunks.literary_form: economic complaint, rebuke, assembly, restitution oath, and enacted sanction
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: great cry opens a social crisis; first-person rebuke leads to assembly, promised restoration, priestly oath, garment-shaking act, and congregational assent
chunks.defensible_basis: Complaint and restitution procedure form one complete crisis-resolution scene.

chunks.literary_form: governor-practice defense and remembrance prayer
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: dated gubernatorial retrospective and repeated contrast with former governors conclude in a direct remembrance petition
chunks.defensible_basis: The closing prayer evaluates the narrated practice and should not be detached.

chunks.literary_form: successive intrigue, open-letter and prophetic-test scenes, completion, fear, and continuing correspondence
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: repeated adversarial invitations and messages escalate to the Shemaiah test; wall completion and adversary reaction supply the outcome before the chapter closes with correspondence
chunks.defensible_basis: The successively varied threats are one campaign whose narrated outcome is the completed wall and altered adversary response.
chunks.low_hold: Embedded open-letter wording, prophetic-test vocabulary, bribery/fear claims, and the source notice at 6:14 require independent review; no identity, prophecy, or providence ruling is made.

chunks.literary_form: security appointments and genealogical inquiry setup
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: after-wall appointments and gate orders move to first-person resolve to enroll by genealogy, introducing the found register
chunks.defensible_basis: The sparse-city problem and enrollment resolve frame why the register follows.
chunks.low_hold: The relationship between security measures, resettlement need, and genealogy is structurally clear but should not authorize historical reconstruction.

chunks.literary_form: returnee and office register with disputed genealogies, totals, gifts, and settlement close
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: document introduction governs family/place totals, servants, disputed priestly claims, aggregate totals, gifts, and settlement formula
chunks.defensible_basis: Subregisters are parts of one found genealogical record and its administrative closure.
chunks.low_hold: Names, totals, tirshatha terminology, purity/exclusion vocabulary, and Ezra-list parallels must remain evidence-only; do not harmonize identities or counts.

chunks.literary_form: Torah-reading, interpretation, mourning-to-joy assembly
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: unified gathering requests the scroll; reading, explanation, communal response, instruction not to mourn, and joyful dismissal complete the assembly
chunks.defensible_basis: Reading, making sense, and the assembly's corrected response are one communicative event.
chunks.low_hold: The syntax and translation of giving the sense/understanding at 8:7-8 require qualified Hebrew and reception review; no theory of translation or legal authority is selected.

chunks.literary_form: festival discovery, proclamation, construction, observance, and daily reading
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: second-day leader gathering discovers the written instruction; proclamation leads to booth construction and seven-day observance
chunks.defensible_basis: Discovery and implementation are one festival episode.

chunks.literary_form: fasting assembly and sustained historical confession-prayer
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: dated assembly separates, reads, confesses, and is summoned to bless; second-person prayer continues through the present-servitude lament
chunks.defensible_basis: The historical recitation is one sustained confessional address whose movements depend on repeated rebellion-mercy cycles.
chunks.low_hold: Speaker plurality, divine-agency wording, canonical echoes, and historical recitation permit internal movements but must not become doctrinal, chronological, or intertext authority.

chunks.literary_form: written covenant transition, sealed-name register, and communal stipulations
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: because-of-all-this written commitment introduces sealers; those who join them bind themselves by oath and enumerate obligations through the house-of-God refrain
chunks.rejected_alternative: Neh.9.38 / Neh.10.1-27 / Neh.10.28-39; MT Neh.10.1-40 as one unit
chunks.defensible_basis: The document act, names of sealers, participating constituency, and stipulations form one covenant-record complex.
chunks.low_hold: WEB 9:38 = MT 10:1 and WEB 10:1-39 = MT 10:2-40; oath, marriage, Sabbath, tithe, firstfruits, priestly and Levite terms need specialist review without legal/cultic authority.

chunks.literary_form: resettlement lot and commendation notice
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: leaders' residence, one-in-ten lot, and blessing of volunteers state the population policy before its register
chunks.defensible_basis: The decision has a distinct administrative function but also governs the following resident list.
chunks.low_hold: A larger Neh.11.1-24 policy-plus-register unit is equally defensible and should remain an appealable alternative.

chunks.literary_form: Jerusalem resident and service register
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: register heading organizes Judah, Benjamin, priests, Levites, gatekeepers, servants, singers, and royal liaison within Jerusalem
chunks.defensible_basis: Constituency subsections share the single function of accounting for Jerusalem's residents and service roles.
chunks.low_hold: Office titles, names, totals, and possible source seams are evidence only; do not identify repeated persons across records.

chunks.literary_form: Judah and Benjamin village-settlement register
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: with respect to villages shifts geography from Jerusalem residents to settlements and their fields
chunks.defensible_basis: The Judah and Benjamin subsections share a non-Jerusalem settlement function.

chunks.literary_form: priestly and Levitical succession and service register
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: successive headings move from return-era priests and Levites through high-priest generations to heads and service divisions, ending with an archival-time notice
chunks.defensible_basis: Subregisters jointly establish succession and service arrangements before the dedication scene.
chunks.low_hold: Names, generations, archival terminology, and source notices require external historical/textual expertise; no chronology or identity harmonization is authorized.

chunks.literary_form: wall dedication, purification, two processions, sacrifices, and communal joy
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: dedication summons Levites and musicians; purification precedes two first-person-arranged thanksgiving companies that converge in worship and great joy
chunks.defensible_basis: Preparation, paired processions, convergence, sacrifice, and joy constitute one dedication event.
chunks.low_hold: Processional geography, mixed memoir/report voice, musical offices, and duplicated company structure allow exact internal seams but the whole ceremony is safer.

chunks.literary_form: storeroom, portion, and cultic-service appointment summary
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: on-that-day appointment formula shifts from ceremony to durable collection and service arrangements
chunks.defensible_basis: Collection oversight and provision for singers, gatekeepers, priests, and Levites form one administrative aftermath.
chunks.low_hold: Tithe, portion, purification, and office vocabulary require specialist review without cultic or ecclesial authority.

chunks.literary_form: public reading and separation response
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: on-that-day Torah reading produces discovery and immediate communal action
chunks.rejected_alternative: Neh.13.1-3 joined with Neh.12.44-47 or Neh.13.4-14
chunks.defensible_basis: Reading and response form a compact reform preface.
chunks.low_hold: Translation and reception of assembly/exclusion terminology must not define ethnicity, canon, marriage doctrine, or contemporary policy.

chunks.literary_form: Tobiah storeroom problem, return, corrective action, restored portions, and remembrance prayer
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: before-this administrative breach is narrated during Nehemiah's absence; return, anger, cleansing, reappointment, restored giving, and remember-me prayer close the reform
chunks.defensible_basis: Problem, consequences, correction, implementation, and prayer are one reform episode.
chunks.low_hold: Chronology, personal identities, pollution/cleansing, tithe, and remembrance wording remain evidence-only and require qualified review.

chunks.literary_form: Sabbath commerce confrontation, gate enforcement, and remembrance prayer
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: in-those-days observation leads to warning, rebuke, gate closure, guard order, merchant confrontation, Levitical purification, and prayer
chunks.defensible_basis: Observed violation and narrated enforcement form one complete corrective sequence.
chunks.low_hold: Sabbath, commerce, threat, gate, purification, and mercy language cannot authorize legal practice or theology.

chunks.literary_form: marriage-language and priestly-household reform with closing administrative summary and remembrance prayers
chunks.deciding_marker_or_seam: also-in-those-days opens the final confrontation; rebuke, oath, Solomon analogy, priestly expulsion, purification, appointments, and repeated remembrance petitions close the memoir
chunks.defensible_basis: The final corrective episode and its summary appointments are bound by purification language and remembrance closures.
chunks.low_hold: Marriage, ethnicity, language, violence, covenant, priesthood, expulsion, and purity terms are exceptionally sensitive; preserve Neh.13.23-29 / 13.30-31 as a viable split and require human or external Hebrew, historical, and reception review.

overall_rationale: This proposal deliberately prefers larger coherent memoir, report-prayer-response, register, opposition-response, assembly, dedication, and reform units. Hebrew paragraphing, accents, morphology, qere/ketiv, Persian/Aramaic administrative vocabulary, and WEB/MT versification are evidence only. Exact narrower alternatives are preserved for synthesis; no claim here decides chronology, identity, authorship, history, doctrine, law, cult, ethnicity, marriage, textual preference, or canonical authority.
